source_state: Working tree of branch claude/project-thread-x6v0sk; source identity is bound by SHA-256.
result: Narrowed. (1) On all rational rays of Q^3 (integer vectors not all even) the function exotic(v) = (1 + sgn v)/3 is a frame function, takes the values 0, 1/3, 2/3, and is not quadratic (BornRationalRayObstruction). (2) On Q(i)^3, a frame function whose value on Gaussian-integer vectors not all divisible by 1+i depends only on the residues modulo 2 of the six integer coordinates is 1/3 on all those vectors (BornGaussianMod2ClassRigidity, 56 explicit frames). The node stays CONDITIONAL.
proof_boundary: Both modules type-check with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. (1) is a statement about Q^3 (real frames only); it does not decide whether every frame function on Q(i)^3 rays is quadratic. (2) closes the residue-mod-2 class ansatz on Q(i)^3 only; finer moduli and non-class functions are not covered. Whether the Q^3 function extends to a frame function on Q(i)^3 is not decided.

limits: BornRationalRayObstruction concerns Q^3 only: frames are triples of pairwise orthogonal integer vectors not all even; non-real (Gaussian) frames are not considered there.
The non-quadraticity statement excludes rational symmetric 3x3 forms agreeing with exotic(v)*(a^2+b^2+c^2) on all rays; it is shown on seven explicit rays.

BornGaussianMod2ClassRigidity assumes the value depends only on the six coordinate residues modulo 2 on (1+i)-primitive Gaussian-integer vectors; it says nothing about functions outside that ansatz, and the value 1/3 is not stated outside those vectors.

Not proved: existence or non-existence of a non-quadratic frame function on Q(i)^3 rays; whether the exotic Q^3 function extends to Q(i)^3 (exact linear-algebra probes on Gaussian boxes of radius 2 found no obstruction and no extension formula).
Effect additivity and the carrier remain supplied; the node status is unchanged.
